notes.title: Nintendo Switch - Release!
notes.notes:
Extremely aggressive pillows are not just on Steam anymore. Bulanci have besieged the Nintendo Switch console as well now. 🌟 

On the enclosed map, you can see when the game is available in which region. With an improved user interface and artificial intelligence, the hero factory, and more stuff, the new version of Bulanci brings fun for up to eight players on one device.
All enhancements will be released for the PC version this year as well, so you can expect a big update on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509720/05693dd3b622a74af14d430a19ea3dcd8162808b.png[/img]

[h2]What does the Nintendo Switch version include?[/h2]
 
[h3]Environments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fairy-Tale
[*] Factory
[*] Disco
[*] Kids’ Room
[/list]

[h3]Game Modes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Deathmatch
[*] Team deathmatch
[*] Capture the Flag
[*] Elite Training
[/list]

[h3]History Book[/h3]
[list]
[*] 11 chapters about the origin and history of Bulanci
[*] including 4 short videos
[/list]

[h3]Hero Factory[/h3]
[list]
[*] An increased number of maps for the current environments
[*] Achievements for deeds in the game
[*] Local multiplayer for up to 8 players on one device
[/list]

notes.title: Update #9 EA ver. 2.9 - Online Multiplayer
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509720/6df292105012b0ad51c5783365d100f993829260.png[/img]

It is here! The Bulanci multiplayer is live! Toodom! Finally, you can play pillow fights with others online. Finally, you can show everyone your skills in eliminating feather foes – a good connection is mandatory, of course. ;)
You’re in for a ride. Soon, we will announce a tournament, and the winner can earn a nice prize. However, it won’t be easy, because we will also come to test your mettle.
The fun stuff doesn’t end here, though. Very soon, we will launch the leaderboards, where you can fight to get to the very top in each season. We are excited to see what kind of marksmen get to stand on the legendary Bulymp. We have much more in store for you, so stay tuned until next time.

[previewyoutube=6ItqH0dcPNk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Big Update #1 ver. EA 1.6
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509720/5ce342a64e0231effdeaaf4c20b7deb8a951af24.png[/img]

For all the lovers of the Bulanci nation, we’ve got some big news today!

In our first major update, Bulanci will infiltrate your room. 

In our new setting  KIDS ROOM, you can look forward to an interesting twist of the game mechanics. Face the feared robot, who goes around the room in all directions. Assault the kids’ train and take control over the battlefield. And the best for last – you will taste the battle to transcend you to higher levels of being!

Let’s take a look at three interesting objects, which will appear in the Kids room.

[h2]Trampoline[/h2]
The trampoline serves as a fast transport between individual levels. Run at the trampoline, wait for your Bulanek to jump on it, and whee… you fly to a higher level!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509720/7de41365a3b86ee157afb46845c90e78a39a1f97.png[/img]

[h2]Robot[/h2]
The robot is a merciless indomitable fighter. It moves in all directions and doesn’t differentiate between any kinds of feather!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509720/d68bf3139c64a0964e31886aaa8332a0625af339.png[/img]

[h2]Train[/h2]
Take a wild ride in the train! Just start the locomotive, and your pillowcase will flutter in the wind. You will gain one incredible advantage on top: as the first Bulanek in the world, you will be able to shoot in all directions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509720/2008e6c1be49dd6a4ba88e4b171dc8411c374c4a.png[/img]

There’s much more of it… Who is slow gets the blow! So let’s hurry to the Kids room!

[h2]Multiplayer[/h2]

Online multiplayer is a highly anticipated addition to Bulanci, and we’re hard at work on it day and night. We understand you can easily defeat your loved ones already and have to test your mettle against some real machos in the online world.
Even though we are relatively close to finishing the multiplayer, we want for it to be just perfect. This is why we’ve decided to expand the ranks of our testers and allow you to be a part of it. Since today, we’ve opened the option to join the beta test of our online multiplayer. You can sign up through this form until March 15th:

[url=https://forms.gle/fm1sYxXbqXA5MLD66]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509720/05ee99ec5c8062a6d3ebfc28f5ee470a97611b33.png[/img][/url]
